shortDescription: Create, update or destroy reverse_proxy frontend entry in Sophos UTM

options.name: add_content_type_header
options.description: Whether to add the content type header or not.

options.name: address
options.description: The reference name of the network/interface_address object.

options.name: allowed_networks
options.description: A list of reference names for the allowed networks.

options.name: certificate
options.description: The reference name of the ca/host_key_cert object.

options.name: comment
options.description: An optional comment to add to the object.

options.name: disable_compression
options.description: Whether to enable the compression.

options.name: domain
options.description: A list of domain names for the frontend object.

options.name: exceptions
options.description: A list of exception ref names (reverse_proxy/exception).

options.name: headers
options.description: A dictionary of additional headers to be sent to POST and PUT requests. Is needed for some modules.

options.name: htmlrewrite
options.description: Whether to enable HTML rewrite or not.

options.name: htmlrewrite_cookies
options.description: Whether to enable HTML rewrite cookie or not.

options.name: implicitredirect
options.description: Whether to enable implicit redirection or not.

options.name: lbmethod
options.description: Which loadbalancer method should be used.

options.name: locations
options.description: A list of location ref names (reverse_proxy/location).

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the object that identifies the entry.

options.name: port
options.description: The frontend http port.

options.name: preservehost
options.description: Whether to preserve host header.

options.name: profile
options.description: The reference string of the reverse_proxy/profile.

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state of the object. V(present) creates or updates an object. V(absent) deletes an object if present.

options.name: status
options.description: Whether to activate the frontend entry or not.

options.name: type
options.description: Which protocol should be used.

options.name: utm_host
options.description: The REST Endpoint of the Sophos UTM.

options.name: utm_port
options.description: The port of the REST interface.

options.name: utm_protocol
options.description: The protocol of the REST Endpoint.

options.name: utm_token
options.description: The token used to identify at the REST-API. See U(https://www.sophos.com/en-us/medialibrary/PDFs/documentation/UTMonAWS/Sophos-UTM-RESTful-API.pdf?la=en), Chapter 2.4.2.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether the REST interface's SSL certificate should be verified or not.

options.name: xheaders
options.description: Whether to pass the host header or not.
